question: Which CET bids are due within 30 days?
html:
CET Bids Due Within 30 Days

Three CET opportunities fall between Oct 19 and Nov 18, 2026: the WRA Union Station generator replacement (Oct 28), the MassDOT NEVI installer call (open to Oct 31), and Cambridge neighborhood EV charging (Nov 10) (CET opportunity radar). None of the six COMMBUYS listings is due before 2027 (New England public bids).

Due Before Nov 18

DueOpportunityScopeNotes
Oct 28, 2026WRA Union Station generator replacementGeneratorWorcester, near CET's headquarters
Oct 31, 2026MassDOT NEVI developers' installer call (Global Montello / Applegreen memo)DC fast charging installAn installer call, not a formal bid. The radar suggests offering the same partnership for Applegreen's 2026 Maine NEVI awards
Nov 10, 2026Cambridge neighborhood EV chargingEV chargingFederal-aid. The radar flags MassDOT prequalification and DBE checks

All dates come from the CET opportunity radar.

Just Outside the Window

  • MassWildlife Roger Reed Hatchery generators and ATS, due Nov 25, 2026 (CET opportunity radar).

Already Closed

The radar's October items have passed:

  • LRTA 250 kW generator (Oct 6).
  • Glastonbury WPCF oxygen controllers (Oct 6).
  • Massport Worcester airport 149A RFQ (Oct 8).
  • BPS generator and UPS (Oct 8).
  • Campbell Resource Center generator (Oct 8).
  • SRTA New Bedford DC fast charging (Oct 9).
  • River Road pump station (Oct 15).

The award status of these items is not in the context.

Data Limits

  • The radar is dated Sep 24, 2026. Due dates may have moved or picked up addenda since then.
  • The radar lists dates without years. The 2026 dates above are est. from the generation date.
  • Only 3 of the radar's 86 items are shown, and its action list is cut off. Other near-term bids may exist.
  • The radar notes that automated access was blocked for COMMBUYS, CTsource/BizNet, RI Purchasing and NH DAS. Coverage of those portals is incomplete.
  • The federal awards snapshot lists past awards, not open bids. It does not answer this question.

Next Actions

  • Confirm the current due dates and addenda for Union Station, the NEVI call and Cambridge on the owner portals.
  • Start the Cambridge prequalification and DBE checks now, given the Nov 10 deadline.
  • Draft the NEVI installer response before Oct 31. Prepare a parallel outreach to Applegreen on Maine.
  • Pull the full radar item list and manually check the blocked portals for anything due by Nov 18. Log the results of the closed October bids.
